verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs say it connects to partner tools across AI code generation, security, testing and monitoring. They also describe installing a third-party integration (Snyk) in-product from a repository's Security tab. The evidence never names a marketplace or app directory where developers browse and install integrations. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a browsable marketplace/app directory, a general install flow beyond the Snyk example, breadth of the catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install third-party integrations from a marketplace or app directory

citations.quote: Connect Bitbucket to market-leading partner tools across AI code generation, security, testing, monitoring, and more.
Simply open an existing repository or create a new one and navigate to the Security tab to install the Snyk integration.
Run automatic security scans with out-of-the-box integration with Snyk, or connect to other providers.
